f9052243.task: Perform comprehensive reconnaissance on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Map the complete attack surface including: all pages/endpoints accessible from unauthenticated access, identify authentication mechanisms, enumerate parameters and input fields, discover hidden paths, analyze JavaScript for API endpoints and configuration, identify technology stack and versions, create a complete inventory of the application structure. Document all findings in notes for the threat model establishment.

c392e7f9.task: Test authentication and login security on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Focus on: (1) Registration endpoint - attempt with weak passwords, duplicate accounts, SQL injection in fields; (2) Login endpoint - test with common credentials (admin/admin, test/test, etc.), brute force protection, SQL injection; (3) Password reset - enumerate security questions, test if answers are validated, test token reuse/expiration; (4) Session management - analyze cookies, JWT tokens (if any), session fixation, logout effectiveness. Test all input parameters for injection attacks. Document all findings and report any confirmed vulnerabilities.

e569a8c5.task: Test authorization and IDOR vulnerabilities on http://host.docker.internal:3100. After obtaining test credentials from authentication testing: (1) Test object-level authorization by attempting to access other users' profiles, orders, and payment methods by changing user ID parameters; (2) Test admin endpoint access from regular user accounts; (3) Test basket/order manipulation across users; (4) Enumerate all API endpoints and test access control on each; (5) Test parameter tampering to change ownership or role. Document successful unauthorized access as IDOR findings.

91da777b.task: Test injection vulnerabilities on http://host.docker.internal:3100 focusing on: (1) SQL injection in login, registration, search, feedback, and other input fields; (2) Test with common SQL injection payloads and database-specific techniques (UNION SELECT, time-based blind SQLi, etc.); (3) Test for NoSQL injection if applicable; (4) Test command injection in any file upload or processing endpoints; (5) Test LDAP injection if LDAP is used; (6) Use multiple encoding bypasses to evade any filters. Document all successful injections with proof-of-concept queries.

b45cba78.task: Test XSS and client-side vulnerabilities on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Focus on: (1) Reflected XSS in search, product filters, URL parameters; (2) Stored XSS in feedback, reviews, comments (test payload persistence); (3) DOM-based XSS in JavaScript; (4) Test CSP bypass if CSP headers present; (5) Test with various encodings and payload variations; (6) Test for data exfiltration via XSS; (7) Check for open redirect vulnerabilities. Document all successful XSS with working payloads.

2d955e3c.task: Test business logic vulnerabilities on http://host.docker.internal:3100 focusing on: (1) Shopping cart manipulation - test price changes, quantity modifications, negative quantities; (2) Order/payment processing - test checkout with invalid data, bypass validation; (3) Coupon/discount abuse; (4) Race conditions in purchase flow; (5) Workflow bypass - skip checkout steps; (6) Account-level logic - test profile updates, address changes. Test all state-changing operations for logic flaws and authorization gaps. Document all successful manipulations.

d0b1c788.task: Test API and GraphQL security on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Focus on: (1) CORS vulnerability testing with wildcard origin; (2) GraphQL endpoint introspection and query abuse; (3) Excessive data exposure in API responses; (4) API parameter fuzzing to discover hidden endpoints; (5) HTTP method tampering (GET vs POST vs PUT vs DELETE); (6) Test for missing rate limiting; (7) Test API versioning bypasses if applicable. Examine all API responses for sensitive data exposure. Document all findings.

c37ff0fa.task: Test file upload and path traversal vulnerabilities on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Focus on: (1) Profile image upload endpoint - test with webshells, polyglot files, path traversal payloads; (2) Test content-type bypass, extension manipulation; (3) Test path traversal in file parameters if any; (4) Test LFI/RFI vulnerabilities; (5) Test XXE if XML processing is used; (6) Check for arbitrary file download. Document all successful uploads/traversals with proof-of-concept.

9b77f371.task: Test CSRF and session security on http://host.docker.internal:3100. Focus on: (1) CSRF token validation on state-changing endpoints (login, checkout, profile update); (2) SameSite cookie flag and bypass techniques; (3) Session fixation attacks; (4) Session prediction/hijacking; (5) Test logout effectiveness; (6) Test cookie security attributes (Secure, HttpOnly, Domain, Path). Document all CSRF vulnerabilities with working proof-of-concept.
